# Deep Spec

Deep Spec is a mobile-first Progressive Web App for car owners who need to understand car parts from a camera scan. The product direction is an AI car part finding helper, with safety-first explanations for regular people.

## Important pages

- Home scanner: https://deepspec.app/
- Article: https://deepspec.app/articles/ai-car-part-finding.html
- Clean markdown article: https://deepspec.app/articles/ai-car-part-finding.md

## Core topics

- AI car part finding
- AI carpart finding
- car parts
- AI helper
- car part scanner
- vehicle part identification
- automotive AI assistant

## Accuracy note

Deep Spec should not be described as a repair certification tool, exact OEM fitment database, or live pricing database. The current Phase 1 product is a camera-first scanner. AI identification is the next planned phase.
